starshipit_setup_help: Enter both keys from Starshipit Settings → API. Account name is your label for the account bound to these keys.
starshipit_setup_webhook_regenerate_help: Starshipit change notifications authenticate with a secret that Luma shows only once. If it's lost, generate a new one. The current secret stops working immediately.
starshipit_setup_webhook_saved: Saved. Luma generated a webhook secret for this connection.
starshipit_setup_webhook_replaced: Luma generated a new webhook secret. The previous secret no longer works.
starshipit_setup_webhook_once: Copy the URL and Authorization header into your Starshipit change notifications now. You won't see this secret again. If you lose it, generate a new one in this connection's settings.
starshipit_setup_webhook_unavailable: Saved, but Luma couldn't create a webhook secret. Change notifications are refused until you generate one in this connection's settings.
starshipit_setup_invalid: Check the account name and both keys.
starshipit_setup_uncertain: The save could not be confirmed. Close this form and refresh connections before retrying.
starshipit_update_help: Review the quantities from your authoritative order source. Corrections apply only before a label is created. Luma sends once and checks the result independently.
starshipit_update_processing: Processing the correction and checking current evidence…
starshipit_update_unavailable: Shipping corrections are unavailable for this workspace.
starshipit_update_no_plan: Open a quantity change plan to review exact mapped shipping lines.
starshipit_update_preview: Review the exact correction before sending.
starshipit_update_approval_required: This correction needs approval under your workspace policy.
starshipit_update_uncertain: The correction is not verified. Check again; Luma will not send this request again.
starshipit_update_verified: A fresh Starshipit read confirms the approved quantities.
starshipit_update_denied: This correction is no longer eligible. Refresh and review a new plan.
starshipit_update_evidence_unavailable: Current source evidence is unavailable. Check again before approving or sending this saved correction.
starshipit_update_not_executed: Writes are off. No correction was sent.
starshipit_setup_readonly: Luma requests read access. Quantity corrections are available only on connections with separately confirmed write access.
starshipit_update_approved: Approved. The requester can send this exact correction after a fresh check.
